detail.command:
git reset -q
git checkout -- README.md
echo '--- status after restore ---'; git status --short; echo '(empty = clean)'
if git cat-file -e 87e05bb601a988545be09272d01c792629279b49^{commit} 2>/dev/null; then
  echo 'INCOMING COMMIT PRESENT LOCALLY'
  git log --oneline -1 87e05bb601a988545be09272d01c792629279b49
  git merge --no-edit --no-commit 87e05bb601a988545be09272d01c792629279b49 || echo 'CONFLICT expected'
  python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

p = Path('README.md')
lines = p.read_text().split('\n')

start = lines.index('## Test')
end = lines.index('## Project structure')
assert any(l.startswith('<<<<<<<') for l in lines[start:end]), 'no conflict between Test and Project structure'

new_test = """## Test

```bash
npm test
```

`npm test` runs the whole Vitest suite: the colocated unit tests under `src/**` and the
cross-module integration tests under `tests/**` (`course-data-validation` checks 10 courses x 9
holes; the rest cover physics helpers, the leaderboard and the save manager). Focused subsets:

```bash
npm run test:ui      # UI layer (src/ui)
npm run test:input   # input and developer tools (src/input, src/dev)
npm run test:camera  # camera system (src/camera)
npm run test:watch   # re-run affected tests on change
```

Every suite in the repository runs under Vitest: there is no second runner and no compile step in
front of the tests.
""".split('\n')

out = lines[:start] + new_test + lines[end:]
out = [l for l in out if not l.startswith('- There is no aggregate test script')]
text = '\n'.join(out)

for marker in ('<<<<<<<', '=======', '>>>>>>>'):
    assert marker not in text, marker
assert '## Current state' in text, 'incoming rewrite missing'
assert '## Known gaps' in text, 'incoming rewrite missing'

p.write_text(text)
print('README.md resolved, %d lines' % len(out))
PY
  git add -A
  echo '--- conflict markers ---'; git grep -n -E '^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>|=======)$' || echo none
  echo '--- sections ---'; grep -n '^## ' README.md
  echo '--- merge state ---'; test -f .git/MERGE_HEAD && cat .git/MERGE_HEAD || git rev-parse --git-dir
  set -e
  echo '===== typecheck ====='; npm run typecheck
  echo '===== test ====='; npm test 2>&1 | tail -n 8
  echo '===== build ====='; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -n 8
  echo '===== ALL CHECKS DONE ====='
else
  echo 'INCOMING COMMIT MISSING LOCALLY'
  echo '--- remote heads matching readme ---'; git ls-remote --heads origin | grep -i readme || echo 'no matching remote branch'
fi
